_comment: Non-secret config for the Dynamic Gateway hub proxy -- the top-level launcher for everything
under web/dynamic-gw/. Its tiles navigate by URL to dyngw-v2-console (8773) and to the three
pages of dyngw-admin-console (8774): registry, linkage report and documentation.
This page is a pure launch menu and calls no service itself.
No password here: it is read from the environment variable named below, falling back to the
gitignored .claude/settings.local.json 'env' block at the repo root (same value the MCP
The 'services' block is deliberately IDENTICAL across every console under web/: each proxy
exposes all five services at /api/ottk/*, /api/dttk/*, /api/dealid/*, /api/tf/* and
/api/dyngw/*, so a page can reach any of them without its console being re-wired first. An
unused route costs nothing (no session is opened until the first call to that key).
Port 8775 keeps this server clear of web/individual/ (8765-8772), dyngw-v2-console (8773)
